ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, P is the larger conducting circular ring on the outside, and Q is the smaller conducting circular ring located inside P. The crosses indicate that the direction of the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface inward, which corresponds to vertically downward in the problem; these crosses are distributed only in the annular region between ring P and ring Q, and there is no magnetic field inside ring Q. Reasoning: The magnetic field is vertically downward and increases uniformly with time. For ring Q, no magnetic field passes through the area it encloses, so the magnetic flux through ring Q does not change, and no induced current is produced. For ring P, the area it encloses includes the annular magnetic-field region between P and Q, so the downward magnetic flux through ring P increases, and an induced current will be produced. According to Lenz's law, the induced current in ring P must produce a vertically upward magnetic field to oppose the increase of the downward magnetic flux. From the right-hand rule, the current direction that produces a vertically upward magnetic field is counterclockwise.

method.method_draft: 先从图中识别：P是外侧大圆环，Q是内侧小圆环，叉号磁场只分布在P、Q之间的环形区域，Q内部没有磁场。再结合题干文字：磁场方向竖直向下且随时间均匀增强。对每个导电圆环分别用法拉第电磁感应定律判断磁通量是否变化：Q环所围面积内没有磁场穿过，所以磁通量不变，不产生感应电流；P环所围面积包含P与Q之间的磁场区域，因此穿过P环的竖直向下磁通量增大，会产生感应电流。由楞次定律，P环中的感应电流应产生竖直向上的磁场来阻碍向下磁通量的增加。用右手定则判断，能产生竖直向上磁场的电流方向为逆时针。因此只有P环中有感应电流，方向为逆时针。
